Traffic Advisory – Winnipeg Police are aware of a demonstration this afternoon in the downtown area.

Traffic disruptions are currently occurring near Portage Avenue and Donald Street. Motorists are encouraged to avoid the area and use alternate routes where possible.

The closure only applies to Westbound Portage traffic. Eastbound at present continues to move.

Winnipeg Transit riders should check official Transit channels for rerouting information.

Updates will be provided here as needed.

@WinnipegTMC
